description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab (RCMSEP) celebrated Diwali with a fellowship evening on 5th November 2026 at Indriya Mishran, Mahakali Road, Andheri East.

The evening was filled with laughter, warmth and festive cheer as members came together to celebrate the spirit of Diwali. It was a wonderful opportunity to strengthen bonds of friendship, foster camaraderie and cherish the joy of togetherness.

The fellowship truly reflected Rotary’s enduring values of Friendship, Fellowship and Service Above Self, making it a memorable evening for all.
